bagPolicy.summary: The venue allows only clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC tote bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutch bags up to 6” x 9”. All bags will be searched upon entry.
allowed: CLEAR plastic, vinyl or PVC tote bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
small clutch bags no larger than 6” x 9”
prohibited: Bags that do not meet the bag policy
bagPolicy.note: The small clutch bags don’t need to be clear.

parking.note: Parking at the venue requires a purchased parking pass. Parking lots typically open 1 hour before the gates open. Check social pages for official times.

rideshare.note: For taxis and rideshares, use the southeast entrance off Ridgeland Avenue.

concessions.note: Credit Union 1 Amphitheatre offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Koko's Bavarian provides German-inspired sausages and pretzels, while general concessions offer popcorn, nachos, and a selection of drinks.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible Parking is located just outside of Gate 4 on the southwest side of the venue, in front of the Premier Parking lot. All venue entrances at Credit Union 1 Amphitheatre are wheelchair accessible.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: You can't leave and come back in, so only leave when you're done for the night. If the venue is evacuated for severe weather, you can re-enter once the all clear is given, so keep your ticket ready to be scanned again.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Collect will-call tickets at the box office in the south plaza near the Fast Lane. Bring photo ID matching the purchaser’s name. Contact Ticketmaster Customer Service for name changes.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Parking and gate times vary by event. Parking lots typically open 1 hour before the gates, and official times are posted on the venue's social pages.
